title: Red Dead 2 Costs You $1.18 an Hour. Worth It?
caption:
Red Dead Redemption 2 is $59.99 on Steam and takes about 51 hours to beat (HowLongToBeat main story): $1.18 an hour. A $12 movie ticket for 2 hours is $6 an hour. Go 100% (about 196 hours) and it drops to 31 cents an hour. Our own math.
How many hours have you put into Red Dead 2?

Sources: Steam store (US price), HowLongToBeat
ig_first_line: A movie costs you $6 an hour. Red Dead 2 costs $1.18. Go 100% and it's 31 cents.
